title: Chat-Coords(X-Pinger)
description: Give your friends your coords at a fast speed
body:
**Have you ever been in a situation where you needed to quickly send your coordinates to your friends?**

With this mod, it's as easy as pressing two buttons. Favorite players for instant access, or share your coordinates publicly with everyone. Just press **J** and the GUI will open.
Or even press **^** for instant alert to all your favorites
